stops.name: Cirque de Gavarnie
stops.detail: The Cirque de Gavarnie (French pronunciation: [siʁk də ɡavaʁni]) is a vast cirque in the central Pyrenees, in southwestern France, close to the border of Spain. It is within the commune of Gavarnie, the department of Hautes-Pyrénées, and the Pyrénées National Park. Major features of the cirque are La Brèche de Roland (Roland's Pass) and the Gavarnie Falls.
